AUTHOR: Paraschiv, M; Padrino, R; Casari, P; Bigal, E; Scheinin, A; Tchernov, D; Anta, AF
TITLE: Classification of Underwater Fish Images and Videos via Very Small Convolutional Neural Networks
VENUE: JOURNAL OF MARINE SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING
REGION: Eastern Mediterranean off Haifa, Israel (THEMO deep and shallow moorings); training data from mixed sources
SPECIES: Thunnus alalunga, Seriola dumerili, Scomber scombrus, Coryphaena hippurus, Trachurus mediterraneus, Xiphias gladius
DATA: Symbiosis dataset (51,260 segments from private/public underwater photos and videos); Symbiosis-NCC; QUT + NOAA Labeled Fishes in the Wild; own THEMO sea-trial images (24 + 115 segments)
V_EV: Sec. 4.1-4.2: optical pipeline activates for a fish 'at a distance of 1 m to 10 m from one or more cameras'; 'The system was 5 to 25 m below the surface'
D2: 60/20/20 per species (30,646/10,413/10,201 segments), segments from same video kept in one set
D_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'we kept segments from the same videos together in the same set ... avoiding that very similar images from the same video spread from the training set'
R_EV: Sec. 4.2/Table 9: multi-class accuracy on Deep Themo (24) and Shallow Themo (115) sea-deployment segments, e.g. VGG16 86.11% / 32.46% vs 51.37% in Table 4
C_EV: no statement found (softmax classification with voting; no score threshold, reject or unsure rule reported)
ARCH: Very small CNNs (10-50k params), VGG16 (pretrained, last layer retrained), Chollet CNN, MobileNetV3; SORT tracking with Mean/Max/Voting fusion; RetinaNet-based segmentation (Levy et al.)
NOTE: Training dataset compiled from 'private and public data sources' of underwater photos/videos (some web/Wikipedia images) - not a monitoring dataset; inclusion rests on own THEMO moored-platform sea trials with quantitative accuracy (Table 9). External test = own sea deployments (different camera/site/source) -> R1=Y, R3=Y; field test sets tiny and nearly single-species. D3=Y: NCC<50% similarity filter (Symbiosis-NCC); D4=Y: explicit Mix vs No-mix leakage comparison. Headline (abstract 42%/49%) uses video-grouped split. 'Other species' class is closed-set, not coded C4; C_ALL=NA (no threshold). VGG16 pretraining source unstated -> PRE NR. ENV pelagic offshore (no fitting value).
